clue.text: Working spell without delay

parts.note: a machine that is working is switched on
a spell is a period, a stretch of time

explanation.surface: A spell of work done promptly, with no hold-ups.
explanation.definitionFit: Arriving punctually means turning up with no lateness, as scheduled.

clue.text: Best or worst?

definitions.meaning: best as a verb means defeat, get the better of
worst as a verb also means defeat, despite looking like the opposite of best

explanation.surface: A riddle asking whether something is best or worst.
explanation.walkthrough: Both words look like superlatives and opposites, but each is a verb meaning beat.
explanation.definitionFit: To beat an opponent can be phrased with either verb; both mean conquer.

clue.text: Bursar more confident after rate adjusted

indicators.note: after places the confident word following the reworked letters
an adjusted rate has been altered, so its letters are reordered

parts.note: surer means more confident

explanation.surface: A college bursar feels more confident once the interest rate has been adjusted.
explanation.definitionFit: A bursar manages the finances of a college or school, keeping its funds.

clue.text: Fail to hit French island with weapon that's fired

parts.note: to miss is to fail to hit
île is French for island

explanation.surface: A shot at a French island fails to hit its target.
explanation.definitionFit: A rocket or projectile launched at a target is a fired weapon.

clue.text: Venomous creature in house? Name

parts.note: in astrology each zodiac sign occupies a house; Scorpio is one of them

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a venomous creature is lurking in the house, and wants it named.
explanation.walkthrough: 'house' is the astrological sense: Scorpio is one of the twelve houses of the zodiac.
explanation.definitionFit: This arachnid carries a stinging tail loaded with poison.

clue.text: Courting ad temp prepared — it may lead to romance

indicators.note: prepared in the sense of made ready, worked into a new shape, so the letters are reorganised

explanation.surface: A temp drafts an advertisement for courting partners, hoping for romance.
explanation.definitionFit: Matching would-be partners through software is a way of meeting someone to love.

clue.text: Owner of large farm managed head of cattle with that woman

parts.note: to run a business is to manage it, so managed is ran

indicators.note: head of picks the opening letter of cattle

parts.note: her refers to that woman

explanation.surface: A woman who runs a ranch managed the lead animal of the herd.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who owns or runs an American livestock farm.

clue.text: Upcoming children's author abridged dramatist

indicators.note: in a down clue upcoming means rising, so the letters read from bottom to top
abridged means cut short, so the final letter goes

parts.note: E. Nesbit wrote The Railway Children

explanation.surface: A shortened children's book author previews a playwright.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abridged' cuts NESBIT to NESBI and 'Upcoming' turns it round in this down answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The Norwegian author of A Doll's House and Hedda Gabler was a playwright.

clue.text: Treated shark close to mainland

parts.note: the nurse shark is a species of shark

indicators.note: close to picks the final letter of mainland

explanation.surface: Someone was treated after a shark attack close to the mainland.
explanation.definitionFit: To tend a patient is to care for them medically.

clue.text: Performer associated with Toledo?

parts.note: Toledo in Spain is famed for its blades, so an entertainer who takes such blades down the throat is linked to it

explanation.surface: A query about some entertainer with links to a city.
explanation.walkthrough: Toledo looks like the Ohio city, but Toledo steel is a Spanish name for fine blades.
explanation.definitionFit: A circus act who gulps down a blade is a performer bound up with Toledo steel.

clue.text: Betting odds nevertheless shortened

indicators.note: the synonym loses its final letter, cut short at the end

parts.note: even so means nevertheless, all the same

explanation.surface: A punter grumbles that the odds were nevertheless cut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shortened' trims the last letter from EVEN SO.
explanation.definitionFit: Odds of one to one at the bookmaker are quoted this way, a stake doubled if it wins.

clue.text: Philanderer having more sense round Arab country

indicators.note: the sensible word goes round, enclosing the country

parts.note: wiser means having more sense
Oman is a sultanate on the Arabian Peninsula

explanation.surface: A womanising traveller grows sensible while touring an Arab land.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe a man who chases many lovers casually.

clue.text: Dismiss teller

definitions.meaning: to dismiss an officer from the armed forces in disgrace
a bank clerk who handles money at the counter

explanation.surface: A bank sacks one of its counter staff.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means expel from military service; the noun is a person who pays out and receives money.

clue.text: Drive mad in huge complex around noon

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go around the single letter
complex as an adjective means intricate, tangled, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: N is short for noon, twelve o'clock

explanation.surface: Being stuck in a huge building complex at midday would drive anyone mad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'complex' reads as a noun for a group of buildings, but it is the adjective that scrambles the letters; the noon letter lands after the U.
explanation.definitionFit: To unbalance someone's mind is to send them crazy.

clue.text: Famous horse reviewed, along with others we trained, in US TV series

indicators.note: reviewed read as re-viewed, looked at again from the other end, so the name runs backwards

parts.note: Red Rum was the racehorse that won Britain's Grand National steeplechase three times in the 1970s

indicators.note: trained in the sense of drilled into shape, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A famous racehorse is reviewed alongside others we have trained, as if on American television.
explanation.walkthrough: Red Rum is the great Aintree steeplechaser; 'reviewed' means viewed again backwards, and 'trained' sounds like horse training but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The Angela Lansbury mystery drama ran on American network television for twelve seasons.

clue.text: Tense Italian stronghold — a time for revenge

parts.note: T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense
a fort is a stronghold

explanation.surface: A tense time at an Italian fortress, ripe for revenge.
explanation.definitionFit: Retaliation in kind, paying back blow for blow, is retribution.

clue.text: Inebriate daughter, after dash in dark, collapsed

indicators.note: after places the daughter's letter at the end
in puts the dashing word inside the reworked letters
collapsed means fallen apart, so these letters are rebuilt

parts.note: to dash is to run

explanation.surface: A drunk daughter collapses after dashing about in the dark.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram of the dark letters is DKAR, with the dash word going in after its first letter; the daughter's letter then comes at the very end, not the start.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun, an inebriate is someone habitually intoxicated by alcohol.

clue.text: Look at occupying B&B, say, for livelihood

indicators.note: the reading word sits inside, occupying the guest house letters

parts.note: B&B is short for bed and breakfast, spelt out as B and B
to read a text is to look at it
to utter is to say

explanation.surface: Reading in a bed and breakfast is someone's way of making a living.
explanation.definitionFit: A person's basic income or staple work is idiomatically their daily bread and its spread.

clue.text: In hospital, ask a nurse, a native of Juneau?

indicators.note: in signals that the letters lie inside the following words

explanation.surface: A patient in hospital asks a nurse where she comes from.
explanation.definitionFit: Juneau is the state capital in the far north-west of the US, so someone born there is from that state.

clue.text: Lots met up excitedly, full of energy — indefinite number

indicators.note: the agitated letters are full of, containing, the energy symbol
excitedly suggests agitation, so the letters are stirred up

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy
in mathematics n stands for an unspecified, indefinite number

explanation.surface: Lots of people met up excitedly, full of energy, in uncounted numbers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'indefinite number' looks like the definition, but it supplies the mathematician's n at the end; the answer itself means lots.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal word for a great many, too many to count.

clue.text: Frisk doctor entering prison

indicators.note: the doctor is entering, going into, the prison

parts.note: gaol is the British spelling of jail
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A doctor is searched on entering a prison.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frisk' suggests a search, but here it is the verb to leap playfully.
explanation.definitionFit: Both verbs mean skip and caper about playfully, like a lamb.

clue.text: Postal system first-rate? Complain bitterly about modifications, primarily

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, written AI in crosswords

indicators.note: the complaining word goes about, surrounding the initial

parts.note: to rail is to complain bitterly

indicators.note: primarily picks the opening letter of modifications

explanation.surface: Someone asks if the post is excellent, then moans about the changes made to it.
explanation.definitionFit: Letters sent by aircraft form a service of mail delivery overseas.

clue.text: Actual leader of Moroccan kingdom

parts.note: real means actual

indicators.note: leader of picks the opening letter of Moroccan

explanation.surface: The actual leader of the Moroccan kingdom.
explanation.definitionFit: A domain ruled by a monarch is a royal territory.

clue.text: Printing error about hotel, relating to violent storm

indicators.note: the error goes about, around the letter

parts.note: a typo is a printing mistake
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet
on means relating to, concerning

explanation.surface: A misprint in a hotel report about a violent storm.
explanation.definitionFit: A tropical cyclone of the western Pacific is a fierce wind storm.

clue.text: Aquatic bird in burnt small pasty?

parts.note: burnt food turns black
S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
pasty as an adjective means pale, which is wan

explanation.surface: A bird found in a burnt little pasty, a pastry gone badly wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pasty' reads as the pie, but it is the adjective meaning pale.
explanation.definitionFit: An Australian waterfowl with dark plumage, once thought impossible by Europeans.

clue.text: Tear off to collect ten more

indicators.note: the rearranged letters collect, taking in, the numeral
off in the sense of wrong, out of order, so the letters are disarranged

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral for ten

explanation.surface: Someone tears off to pick up ten more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' rearranges TEAR into ETRA, and 'to collect' puts X inside after the E.
explanation.definitionFit: Additional or further, beyond the usual amount.

clue.text: Lay in rum, rum for famous person

indicators.note: rum as an adjective means odd, strange, so the letters come out oddly ordered

explanation.surface: Stock up on rum, rum fit for a celebrity.
explanation.walkthrough: The second 'rum' is the adjective meaning odd, signalling a rearrangement of LAY IN RUM.
explanation.definitionFit: A celebrated figure is a star, someone who shines brightly in public.

clue.text: Single item editor agreed

parts.note: a unit is a single item

explanation.surface: An editor approves a single item.
explanation.definitionFit: People in accord are at one, joined in a common view.
